details:
Sometime event or game world can lasts very long(lasts until hardlimit of 7 days), doesn't necessarily meaning it's a bad thing, but long live instance can have many issues, like recent game worlds do tends to sync tons of the data on entry, which is good thing for game world due to more dynamic contents. But it also make older instance less attractive to the people want fresh rounds, some people wants to find more active instance, or sometime people will went AFK/fall a sleep and make the inactive instance lasts for longer than it should, some people hold the instance for game certain game world contents that's only generated unless you are inside, and some game(or any worlds) do require fresh start for the most contents to enjoy, all of these requires the awareness to the time and other infos, some people do put the create time on the title, but TBH the time often being cut-out and hard to understand(or things like this non-Latin bug: https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/event-calendar-display-issue-when-the-event-name-is-in-japanesenon-latin ). What I suggest:

1. Add instance create time and uptime on the right side menu

2. Filter to allow sorting by time, group, filter out groups, or so

3. Make the instance ID constant

4. One button to join last instance(sometime people will crash or went away for other things, and lost progress because they can't found the instance). This should also ignore the Recommended Capacity since they was in the instance and likely had progress in the instance.

5. Showing 'Had joined on y/m/d h:m' on instance .

6. Allow world version codes so people can know what version it is(or was).

7. Allow 'Changelogs' on the tab(besides the Detail/Store/Author), it should be like the world.

8. Allow Group to relate to the world. Just like the changelog, many game or other worlds do have it's own official groups, or fan groups. Having groups meaning it will be easier to find other players to play.

9. Allow multiple authors or Group ownership. The current system think uploader is the author, which can't always be true, sometime 'Group' owns it, they should gets the right for their own world(even that meaning it can be abused, hijacked or other bad things, which they shouldn't), the uploader should listed as uploader, but ownership should change. It should also list who owns the admin rights so it harder to be mistaken or imposed.(It should also viewable somehow when people are in the instance btw)

10. Showing not just the creator, but also the instance owner. Some people will not like it(should have privacy option to hide tbh), but knowing the ownership is also a important stuff since there are too many confuses to such things.

Guess this is all, many modern games do have these basic things, and there's a game world bloom on recent weeks, I feel these are more important than before atm
title: [1953] Modernize instance info(expose instance up/create time, ID/owned group or multiple authors, world version/cahangelogs, join last instance, better sort or so)
